name: BzODZ-EPyr
summary: BzODZ-EPyr is an indole based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug in Russia.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a CB1 receptor agonist with a pKB value of 7.2 and demonstrates that replacing the ketone in 3-carbonylindoles with an oxadiazole spacer does not generally lead to activity loss.

uses.text: BzODZ-EPyr is an indole based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug in Russia.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: It shows that the ketone linker in these cannabinoids can be replaced by an oxadiazole ring without losing activity, a finding that opened the way to a whole new set of compounds.
fact.zh: 它證明這類大麻素中的酮基連結可以換成一個惡二唑環而不喪失活性，這項發現開啟了一整批新化合物的可能。
fact.zhHans: 它证明这类大麻素中的酮基链接可以换成一个恶二唑环而不丧失活性，这项发现打开了一整批新化合物的可能。
